scope: Explain the existing minimum-one-status rule for the Schedule Inspector checkbox group.

verified_gap.issue: The schema rejects empty status arrays, and the UI silently re-checks the last option without explaining the constraint.
verified_gap.impact: Users could mistake a silent revert for a broken checkbox.

implementation.change: The status group displays “Válassz ki legalább egy státuszt.” using the existing property-help style and connects the hint with aria-describedby. The existing selected-value guard and schedule.config.set command remain unchanged.
implementation.reuse_review: Reuses existing project-owned helper styling and native ARIA semantics; no external code or dependency added.

acceptance.result: PASS 2/2 real Chromium scenarios at 390px and 1366px
checks: The group is exposed with its visible name and associated minimum-selection description.
Attempting to clear the last selected status leaves it selected, in line with the schema.
A second status can still be selected and persists through the existing Save/Publish lifecycle.

acceptance_boundary: The UI change is locally tested only. Production remains at the preceding deployed Worker and does not include this hint.
